scenes.supernova_script:
Rahul says: I left my village and came to Mumbai.
Rahul says: Leaving my father, my mother, my home behind.
Rahul says: People here said I wouldn't survive the corporate world.
Rahul says: They said, "Speaking fluent English is not for someone like you."
Rahul says: But I refused to believe them.
Rahul says: Because I carry something they can't see.
Rahul says: My father's sacrifice. My mother's prayers.
Rahul says: Their tired hands. Their sleepless nights.
Rahul says: All of it... for me.
scenes.scene_summary:
- Establishes emotional stakes and dignity hook
- Names English early
- Sets up the underdog narrative
scenes.supernova_on_screen_text:
I left my village and came to Mumbai.
Leaving my father, my mother, my home behind.
People here said I wouldn't survive the corporate world.
They said, "Speaking fluent English is not for someone like you."
But I refused to believe them.
Because I carry something they can't see.
My father's sacrifice. My mother's prayers.
Their tired hands. Their sleepless nights.
All of it... for me.

scenes.supernova_script:
Rahul says: Some days, the city feels too loud.
Rahul says: The language feels too foreign.
Rahul says: But then I remember why I left, and I open Supernova AI.
Rahul says: I practice speaking with Miss Nova, my personal AI teacher.
Rahul says: She understands my exact level and builds a plan just for me.
Rahul says: And the best part? She never judges me.
Rahul says: I can make a thousand mistakes at midnight, and she just corrects me.
Rahul says: She even explains the logic in Hindi, so I never feel lost.
Rahul says: I don't just read; I speak out loud until the words come naturally.
Rahul says: I'm not competing with this city. I'm just getting better every day.
Rahul says: Because I made a promise — to them.
scenes.scene_summary:
- Introduces Supernova AI and Miss Nova
- Lands personalization (a) and privacy/no-judgement (b) beats
- Includes logic in native language (g) and speaking (c) beats

scenes.supernova_script:
Rahul says: One day soon, I'll walk into that manager interview with my head held high.
Rahul says: I'll speak English confidently, and I'll make them proud.
Rahul says: Not because I was the smartest, but because I stopped wasting time scrolling feeds.

Rahul says: It reminded me who I'm doing this for.
